segments.t: Jesus said these things,
then lifting up his eyes to heaven,
segments.note: 「then」は καὶ の訳

segments.t: he said,
segments.note: 主語の「he」は Ἰησοῦς を受ける

segments.t: “Father, the time has come.
Glorify your Son,
that your Son may also glorify you;
segments.note: 「your」（2回目）と「also」は英語の補い

segments.t: even as you gave him authority over all flesh,
segments.note: 「over」は ἐξουσία＋属格のほぐし

segments.t: so he will give eternal life
segments.note: 「so」は καθὼς…ἵνα の対応として英語が補う

segments.t: to all whom you have given him.
This is eternal life,
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: that they should know you, the only true God,
and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
segments.note: 「him」は ὃν の先行詞として英語が補う

segments.t: I glorified you on the earth.
I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
segments.note: 分詞 τελειώσας を「I have accomplished」と節化

segments.t: Now,
Father,
glorify me
with your own self
segments.note: παρὰ σεαυτῷ を「with your own self」と訳す

segments.t: with the glory
which I had with you
before the world existed.
segments.note: τοῦ＋不定詞 εἶναι を「the world existed」と節化

segments.t: “I revealed your name
to the people whom you have given me out of the world.
They were yours,
and you have given them to me.
They have kept your word.
Now they have known
that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
segments.note: 「things」は πάντα への補い

segments.t: for the words which you have given me I have given to them;
and they received them,
and knew for sure that I came from you.
segments.note: 「for sure」は ἀληθῶς のほぐし

segments.t: They have believed that you sent me.
I pray for them.
I don’t pray for the world,
but for those whom you have given me,
segments.note: 「those」は ὧν の先行詞として英語が補う

segments.t: for they are yours.
All things that are mine are yours,
segments.note: 文頭の καὶ（1番）は英語に現れない。「things that are」は τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα のほぐし

segments.t: and yours are mine,
segments.note: 繋辞は前句の ἐστιν と共有

segments.t: and I am glorified in them.
I am no more in the world,
segments.note: 文頭の καὶ（1番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: but these are in the world,
segments.note: 「these」は αὐτοί の訳

segments.t: and I am coming to you.
Holy Father,
keep them through your name
which you have given me,
that they may be one, even as we are.
segments.note: 終わりの「are」の後の ἓν は前句と共有

segments.t: While I was with them
in the world,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「in the world」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: I kept them in your name.
I have kept those whom you have given me.
segments.note: ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι はギリシャ語では「名」にかかるが、WEB は ἐφύλαξα の目的語として読み替える。καὶ（15・17番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: None of them is lost except the son of destruction,
that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
But now I come to you,
and I say these things in the world,
that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
I have given them your word.
The world hated them
because they are not of the world,
even as I am not of the world.
I pray not that you would take them from the world,
but that you would keep them from the evil one.
segments.note: 「one」は πονηροῦ への補い

segments.t: They are not of the world,
even as I am not of the world.
Sanctify them in your truth.
segments.note: 「your」は τῇ ἀληθείᾳ の定冠詞を所有格として訳したもの

segments.t: Your word is truth.
As you sent me into the world,
even so I have sent them into the world.
segments.note: 「even so」は κἀγὼ の対比を表す

segments.t: For their sakes I sanctify myself,
segments.note: 「For their sakes」は ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν のほぐし

segments.t: that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
“Not for these only do I pray,
but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
segments.note: 分詞 πιστευόντων を WEB は未来として訳す。「those」は英語の補い

segments.t: that they may all be one;
even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you,
segments.note: 繋辞はギリシャ語では省略

segments.t: that they also may be one in us;
segments.note: 「one」は前句の ἓν の反復

segments.t: that the world may believe that you sent me.
The glory which you have given me, I have given to them,
that they may be one,
even as we are one,
segments.note: 繋辞はギリシャ語では省略

segments.t: I in them, and you in me,
segments.note: 繋辞はギリシャ語では省略

segments.t: that they may be perfected into one,
that the world may know that you sent me
and loved them, even as you loved me.
Father, I desire
that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am,
segments.note: ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι を「they also whom you have given me」と展開

segments.t: that they may see my glory which you have given me,
for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you,
but I knew you;
and these knew that you sent me.
I made known to them your name,
segments.note: 文頭の καὶ（1番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: and will make it known;
segments.note: 「it」は τὸ ὄνομά σου を受ける

segments.t: that the love with which you loved me may be in them,
and I in them.”
segments.note: 繋辞は前句の ᾖ と共有
